description: Harden fixes in parallel worktrees, land each fix serially, and prove each regression test red

specs.description: `hexa harden` takes multiple targets and runs hunt and verify phases once for all of them
specs.given: Three files: `hexa-exec/src/spec_author.rs`, `hexa-cli/src/commands/spec_ledger.rs`, and `hexa-exec/src/direct_exec.rs`
specs.when: `hexa harden hexa-exec/src/spec_author.rs hexa-cli/src/commands/spec_ledger.rs hexa-exec/src/direct_exec.rs` is run
specs.then: Hunt and verify phases run once over all three files, and the confirmed findings form one pool to fix

specs.description: `hexa harden` refuses to run with no targets
specs.given: No targets provided
specs.when: `hexa harden` is run with no arguments
specs.then: The command fails with an error message indicating that at least one target must be provided

specs.description: Each confirmed fix is written in its own git worktree in parallel
specs.given: A pool of 29 confirmed findings and `--jobs 4`
specs.then: At most 4 agents run at once, each in its own worktree, and the worktrees are created from the pass's base commit

specs.description: A fix agent never sees the operator's uncommitted files
specs.given: The operator's tree holds an uncommitted file `scratch.rs` and a modified tracked file
specs.when: A fix agent runs for a confirmed finding
specs.then: The agent's cwd is its own worktree made from the pass's base commit; `scratch.rs` and the uncommitted modification are absent there, and the operator's tree is unchanged by the agent

specs.description: A fix is written in two steps: first a regression test, then the fix itself
specs.given: A confirmed finding and a worktree created from the base commit
specs.when: The agent starts writing the fix
specs.then: Step A: the agent writes only a regression test for the finding and commits it as `test(harden): <title> (failing)`. Step B: a second agent session makes the fix and commits it as `fix(harden): <title>`

specs.description: Step B cannot change files created by step A under a `tests/` directory
specs.given: Step A created a test file under `tests/`
specs.when: Step B tries to modify that test file
specs.then: The change is refused, and the run fails with an error indicating that the test is sealed

specs.description: Each fix lands on the branch one at a time, and the gate must fail with the test alone and pass with the fix
specs.given: A pair of commits (step A and step B) for a fix
specs.then: Hexa cherry-picks the step-A commit and runs the gate. The gate fails. Hexa then cherry-picks the step-B commit and runs the gate. The gate passes. The pair is committed to the branch

specs.description: A fix whose test does not fail without the fix is not committed
specs.given: A pair of commits where the gate passes with the test alone
specs.when: The landing phase tries to land the pair
specs.then: Hexa resets the branch to where it was before the pair, drops the fix, and reports it as 'no red test'

specs.description: A fix that no longer applies cleanly is written again on the current branch
specs.given: A confirmed finding and a pair of commits that conflict with the current branch
specs.when: The landing phase tries to cherry-pick the pair
specs.then: The cherry-pick is aborted. The finding gets steps A and B again in a new worktree made from the current head, followed by the red-then-green check

specs.description: A finding that conflicts twice is dropped
specs.given: A confirmed finding and a pair of commits that conflict with the current branch twice
specs.when: The landing phase tries to cherry-pick the pair a second time
specs.then: The cherry-pick is aborted again. The finding is dropped, and the report names it as conflicted

specs.description: The pair is the unit throughout: batching, bisection, and last-chance retry count, cut, and retry a fix as its two commits together
specs.given: A batch of fixes, each with a pair of commits
specs.when: Batching, bisection, or last-chance retry is applied
specs.then: The operations work on the pairs, and a red step-A commit is never taken as a culprit

specs.description: The project names its harden gate in `.hexa/project.json`
specs.given: A project with `.hexa/project.json` containing `harden.gate: "cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings"`
specs.then: The gate defined in `.hexa/project.json` is used

specs.description: A pass with no gate from either place is refused
specs.given: A project with no `.hexa/project.json` and no `--gate` provided
specs.then: The command fails with an error indicating that a gate must be provided

specs.description: Every phase is timed, and the report says where the time went
specs.given: A run of `hexa harden` on three files
specs.then: The report records the wall time of hunt, verify, fix, landing, and the final gate, plus the longest single agent session. The verdict line prints them

specs.description: No recorded time exceeds the run it belongs to
specs.given: Any run of `hexa harden`
specs.then: Every recorded phase time and the longest agent session are non-negative and none exceeds the run's total wall time

specs.description: A phase that did not run is reported as zero, never omitted
specs.given: A `hexa harden` run in which no finding is confirmed, so the fix and landing phases never run
specs.when: The run completes and the report is written
specs.then: The report still lists hunt, verify, fix, landing and the final gate, with fix and landing at zero time; the verdict line prints every phase's time and is not printed without them

specs.description: Any number of targets is one hunt and one pool
specs.given: Any non-empty set of target files
specs.then: Hunt runs once and verify runs once over all the targets together, and every finding confirmed in any target is in the single pool the fix phase draws from

specs.description: Never more than --jobs fix agents at once
specs.given: Any pool of confirmed findings and any `--jobs N` (or none, meaning 4)
specs.then: At no moment are more than N fix agents running, and every agent runs in a worktree made from the pass's base commit, never in the operator's tree

specs.description: Step B never changes step A's tests
specs.given: Any confirmed finding whose step-A commit created files under `tests/`
specs.then: The step-B commit changes none of those files; a step-B change that would is refused and that fix does not land

specs.description: Landing order is finding order, and each landed pair went red then green
specs.given: Any set of fix pairs, whatever order their agents finish in
specs.then: Pairs land in finding order; for every pair that lands, the gate failed after its step-A commit and passed after its step-B commit; every other pair leaves the branch where it was before that pair

specs.description: A finding is written again at most once
specs.given: Any finding whose pair conflicts on cherry-pick
specs.then: The aborted pick leaves the operator's tree as it was before the pick; the finding is rewritten from the current head at most once, and a second conflict drops it and names it in the report

specs.description: Batching cuts and retries a fix as its two commits
specs.given: A batch of three pairs where the second pair's fix makes the gate fail
specs.then: The second pair is dropped as both its commits together; the first and third land with both their commits each

specs.description: A red step-A commit is never a culprit
specs.given: A batch whose gate run fails only because a step-A commit is red, as it is meant to be
specs.then: No step-A commit is named as the culprit, and no step-A or step-B commit lands without the other half of its pair

specs.description: --gate wins; harden.gate is the default; neither is refused
specs.given: Any combination of `harden.gate` present or absent in `.hexa/project.json` and `--gate` given or not
specs.then: The gate used is `--gate` when given, else `harden.gate`; with neither, the pass is refused before any hunt
